entries.note: H2242 supplies origin without the Hitchcock behold/examine derivation.

entries.name: Zia
entries.note: H2127 differs from sweat/swelling. [Strong H2127](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2127.htm).

entries.name: Ziba
entries.note: Strong H6717 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: army; fight; strength. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

strongs.derivation: from the same as H6678 (צוֹבָא); station;

entries.name: Zibeon
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

strongs.derivation: from the same as H6648 (צֶבַע); variegated;

entries.name: Zibiah
entries.note: H6645 refers to H6646; Lord dwells/goat is unsupported. Its generic digital Israelite summary must not obscure that 2 Kings 12:1 and 2 Chronicles 24:1 identify Zibiah as the king's mother. [Strong H6645](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6645.htm).

entries.name: Zichri
entries.note: Remembering is supported; man is not established as another lexical element.
hitchcock: that remembers; that is a man

strongs.strongs_def: Zicri, the name of twelve Israelites

entries.name: Ziddim
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

strongs.strongs_def: Tsiddim (with the article), a place in Palestine

entries.name: Zidkijah
entries.note: The pinned Strong H6667 record supplies this lexical proposal, compatible with Hitchcock's core sense. This dictionary comparison does not establish the etymology as biblical fact. [Strong H6667](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6667.htm).

strongs.derivation: or צִדְקִיָּהוּ; from H6664 (צֶדֶק) and H3050 (יָהּ); right of Jah;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsidkijah, the name of six Israelites

entries.name: Zidon
entries.note: Fishing is supported; hunting/venison should not replace the specific name gloss. Sidon and Zidon are English spelling forms, not different etymologies.

strongs.derivation: or צִידֹן; from H6679 (צוּד) in the sense of catching fish; fishery;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan, and of a place in Palestine

entries.name: Zif
entries.note: Month name; H2099 marks the root relation probable, and this/that is unsupported.

strongs.derivation: probably from an unused root meaning to be prominent; properly, brightness (compare H2122 (זִיו)), i.e. (figuratively) the month of flowers;

entries.name: Ziha
entries.note: H6727 supports drought, not brightness/whiteness. [Strong H6727](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6727.htm).

strongs.derivation: or צִחָא; as if feminine of H6704 (צִחֶה); drought;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsicha, the name of two Nethinim

entries.name: Ziklag
entries.note: Strong H6860 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: measure pressed down. The derivation remains uncertain.

strongs.derivation: or צִיקלַג; (1 Chronicles 12:1,20), of uncertain derivation;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsiklag or Tsikelag, a place in Palestine

entries.name: Zillah
entries.note: H6741 points to H6738; shadow agrees, tingling of the ear is unsupported.
hitchcock: shadow; the tingling of the ear

entries.name: Zilpah
entries.note: H2153 supports a trickling association but does not include mouth. [Strong H2153](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2153.htm).

strongs.derivation: ; from an unused root apparently meaning to trickle, as myrrh; fragrant dropping;

entries.name: Zilthai
entries.note: Shadow agrees; possessive my and talk are not established.

strongs.derivation: from the feminine of H6738 (צֵל); shady;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsillethai, the name of two Israelites

entries.name: Zimmah
entries.note: H2155 points to H2154, which often denotes a bad plan; the lexical range is not a character judgment about the named Israelites.

strongs.strongs_def: Zimmah, the name of two Israelites
a plan, especially a bad one
strongs.kjv_def: heinous crime, lewd(-ly, -ness), mischief, purpose, thought, wicked (device, mind, -ness).

entries.name: Zimran
entries.note: H2175 supports song/music, not vine. [Strong H2175](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2175.htm).

strongs.strongs_def: Zimran, a son of Abraham by Keturah

entries.name: Zimzi
entries.note: No exact name headword or defensible alias was established in the supplied Strong snapshot. Hitchcock: my field; my vine. Keep this name and gloss unresolved; do not guess from a similar spelling.

entries.name: Zin
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

strongs.derivation: from an unused root meaning to prick; a crag;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsin, a part of the Desert

entries.name: Zina
entries.displayMeaning: well-fed; possibly a form of Ziza
entries.note: H2126 itself offers two possibilities; shining/going back is unestablished. [Strong H2126](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2126.htm).

strongs.derivation: from H2109 (זוּן); well-fed; or perhaps an orthographical error for H2124 (זִיזָא);

entries.name: Zion
entries.note: Monument is supported through H6725; raised up/sepulcher are not its explicit gloss. The mountain's biblical identity is not reduced to a lexical reconstruction.

strongs.derivation: the same (regularly) as H6725 (צִיּוּן)lemma צִיוּן missing dagesh, corrected to צִיּוּן;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem

strongs.derivation: from the same as H6723 (צִיָּה) in the sense of conspicuousness (compare H5329 (נָצַח));

entries.name: Zior
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Ziph
entries.note: H2128 differs from mouthful/falsehood; different places and a man share the name. [Strong H2128](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2128.htm).

strongs.derivation: from the same as H2203 (זֶפֶת); flowing;
strongs.strongs_def: Ziph, the name of a place in Palestine; also of an Israelite

entries.name: Ziphron
entries.note: Strong H2202 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: falsehood of a song; rejoicing. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

strongs.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to be fragrant);

entries.name: Zippor
entries.note: H6834 points to H6833; bird/sparrow agrees, crown/desert is unsupported.

entries.name: Zipporah
entries.note: H6855 differs from beauty/trumpet/mourning. [Strong H6855](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6855.htm).

entries.name: Zithri
entries.note: Strong H5644 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: to hide; demolished. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

entries.name: Ziz
entries.note: Flower agrees; branch/hair lock are not independently selected as the place-name meaning.
hitchcock: flower; branch; a lock of hair

entries.name: Ziza
entries.note: H2124 gives prominence; H2126 tentatively suggests Zina may be a spelling error for Ziza. Do not turn that conjecture into an unconditional same-as relation. [Strong H2124](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2124.htm).

strongs.derivation: apparently from the same as H2123 (זִיז); prominence;
strongs.strongs_def: Ziza, the name of two Israelites

entries.name: Zoan
entries.note: Strong H6814 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: motion. The derivation remains uncertain.

entries.name: Zoar
entries.note: Genesis 19:20-22 supplies the little-place naming association.

strongs.strongs_def: Tsoar, a place East of the Jordan

entries.name: Zobah
entries.note: H6678 supports stationed, not army/warring as a direct gloss; Zobebah is a different name. [Strong H6678](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6678.htm).

strongs.derivation: or צוֹבָה; or צֹבָה; from an unused root meaning to station; a station;
strongs.strongs_def: Zoba or Zobah, a region of Syria

entries.name: Zohar
entries.note: H6714 expressly identifies Zohar and gives whiteness; bright agrees, dryness is not the stated derivation. Hittite and Israelite bearers must be distinguished.

strongs.derivation: from the same as H6713 (צַחַר); whiteness;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsochar, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite

strongs.derivation: from an unused root meaning to dazzle;

entries.name: Zoheleth
entries.note: A named stone, not a personal name; the name proposal does not prove the stone's shape or cultic function.

strongs.derivation: feminine active participle of H2119 (זָחַל); crawling (i.e. serpent);
strongs.strongs_def: Zocheleth, a boundary stone in. Palestine

entries.name: Zoheth
entries.note: H2105 explicitly marks origin uncertain. [Strong H2105](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/2105.htm).

entries.name: Zophah
entries.note: Strong H6690 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: viol; honeycomb. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.

strongs.derivation: from an unused root meaning to expand, breadth;

entries.name: Zophar
entries.note: Strong differs from Hitchcock or explicitly leaves derivation unresolved; neither proposal is thereby proved.

entries.name: Zophim
entries.note: Numbers 23:14 identifies the field of Zophim; it is a place designation. [Strong H6839](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6839.htm).

strongs.derivation: plural of active participle of H6822 (צָפָה); watchers;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsophim, a place East of the Jordan

entries.name: Zorah
entries.note: Hornet is supported; leprosy/scab are related-root alternatives, not the explicit gloss of H6880.

entries.name: Zorobabel
entries.note: G2216 points to Zerubbabel H2216; Hitchcock only provides a cross-reference.

strongs.derivation: from H2215 (זָרַב) and H894 (בָּבֶל); descended of (i.e. from) Babylon, i.e. born there;

entries.name: Zuar
entries.note: H6686 supports small, related to the smallness root; Zoar is a distinct place-name, not this man. [Strong H6686](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6686.htm).

entries.name: Zuph
entries.note: Strong H6689 proposes this sense; Hitchcock: that beholds, observes, watches; roof; covering. These are secondary lexical claims, not the biblical text.
hitchcock: that beholds, observes, watches; roof; covering

strongs.derivation: or צוֹפַי; or צִיף; from H6688 (צוּף); honey-comb;
strongs.strongs_def: Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine

entries.name: Zur
entries.note: Rock agrees; besieging is not independently supplied as the selected name sense.

strongs.strongs_def: Tsur, the name of a Midianite and of an Israelite

entries.name: Zuriel
entries.note: H6700 directly gives rock of God; strength is a related figurative expansion. [Strong H6700](https://biblehub.com/hebrew/6700.htm).

strongs.derivation: from H6697 (צוּר) and H410 (אֵל); rock of God;

entries.name: Zurishaddai
entries.note: Strong supports the rock/Almighty compound; my and strength are explanatory expansions, not separately supplied components.
hitchcock: the Almighty is my rock and strength

strongs.derivation: from H6697 (צוּר) and H7706 (שַׁדַּי); rock of (the) Almighty;

entries.name: Zuzims
entries.note: H2104 names a people; doorposts/beauty is not its supplied lexical proposal.
hitchcock: the posts of a door; splendor; beauty

strongs.derivation: plural probably from the same as H2123 (זִיז); prominent;
strongs.strongs_def: Zuzites, an aboriginal tribe of Palestine
